Standardised Test Score Is Required (Any One)SAT, or ACT (American College Test),IELTS** (Academic Test),TOEFL**,C1 Advanced,Pearson Test of English Academic (PTE Academic)Aptitude Scholastic Test (AST)
SAT A minimum total score of 1,350 with at least 650 for evidence-based reading and writing. Essay is not required
IELTS (Academic) A minimum overall score of 7.0 with at least 7.0 for reading and 6.5 for writing
TOEFL iBT (internet-based test) Before 21 Jan 2026 A minimum score of 93, with at least 22 for reading and 22 for writing
A non-refundable application fee of S$15 is payable. You can make the payment via Applicant's Self Service after submitting your online application for admission.
Applicants are required to upload copies of the standardised test scores via Applicant's Self Service after submitting the online application for admission.
